# Methods 
## Cohort description {#sec-cohort}
```{python}
# | echo: false
from pathlib import Path

ROOT_CARDIAC = Path("/media/clement/HD/Santiago/OcularRigidity/FullPipeline/")
from ocularrigidity.data.measurements.cohort import build_cohort, Study

df = build_cohort(root=ROOT_CARDIAC, study=Study.PROSPECTIVE, overwrite=False)
n_patients = df.PatientId.nunique()
n_visits = len(df)
```

We have a total of `{python} n_patients` patients in the study, with a total of `{python} n_visits` visits.
